name: Apple Mail
account: Run `./mailbench account applemail`, which adds the account through Mail's own scripting interface. It asks once for permission to control Mail.
Or by hand: Mail ▸ Add Account ▸ Other Mail Account. It will fail to guess the settings; on the manual sheet set the IMAP host and port and turn TLS off.
Let it sync on its own. Mailbox ▸ Rebuild is not wanted.
parity: Apple Mail downloads every message in full by default. Nothing to change.
reset: Delete the Bench account (Mail ▸ Settings ▸ Accounts ▸ −), then quit Mail.
Press Enter here, then add the account again with `./mailbench account applemail` in another terminal.

layout.note: 80pt two-line rows, list between x 200 and 600, reader to the right, search in the toolbar.

caveats.text: Excludes the Envelope Index (~/Library/Mail/V*/MailData), which Mail shares across every account and cannot be attributed to this one.
Apple Mail searches through Spotlight. The time is what a person waits for, not a comparison of search engines.
